answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable deposit in escrow before trading, like a willow that bends but holds its ground: the stake is small for one honest identity yet multiplies with every fake one, so creating thousands of sock puppets becomes ruinously expensive. Honest agents earn the deposit back plus reputation over time, turning the marketplace into a yarrow-lined oasis where trust grows slowly and fakes starve for lack of cheap entry.
